subject.title: Unify split-view controls into one toolbar row

question: Should Control UI replace the global breadcrumb row with active split-pane controls while split view is active, and move the classic split-view entry action out of the composer?
rationale: Source inspection confirms the current duplicated chrome, but changing global toolbar ownership and composer action placement is a visible Control UI product decision on a protected maintainer-labeled issue.

options.title: Sponsor toolbar unification
options.body: Accept the requested direction and require a focused Control UI implementation with split, classic, narrow, and drag/drop browser proof.

options.title: Keep current ownership
options.body: Keep breadcrumbs and pane headers separate if maintainers prefer explicit route chrome plus per-pane controls over reclaiming vertical space.

options.title: Narrow the change
options.body: Move only the classic split-view entry action out of the composer and defer split-pane toolbar consolidation until broader shell guidance is settled.

recommendation.title: Sponsor toolbar unification
recommendation.body: Accept the requested direction and require a focused Control UI implementation with split, classic, narrow, and drag/drop browser proof.
